scope: Fresh released-default QuantaAlpha search, followed by a declared chronological evaluation. Original-paper and pristine-holdout claims remain false.
search_feedback_period: 2021-01-01 through2021-12-31, exactly source conf_baseline/conf_combined native feedback. This period is part of search selection, not an untouched test.
baseline: Exact four source OHLCV features and unchanged native Qlib preprocessing, LightGBM, CSI300 Top50/drop5, next-open execution and fees.
candidate_rule: Retain every generated candidate/failed attempt. For fixed-library evaluation, union all factors accepted by completed native trajectories, deduplicate exact expressions; do not select on2022-2025 returns. Also report each source-selected trajectory separately without promoting the best evaluation result.
causality_gate: Independently audit expression lags and test prefix invariance using native generated code on full-universe historical HDF prefixes. A factor whose earlier values change when future rows are removed is not eligible for the causal economic claim. Preserve native output and label any leakage-contaminated native result; do not silently patch or select around failures.
completion_gate: all model calls and failed/reserved attempts accounted
actual calculated factors and native backtests present
strict replay or concrete documented replay failure
prefix causality and independent account/metric checks
new-period frozen-library comparison and bounded inference
remaining_limitations: Current release defaults differ from150-factor/ten-direction paper experiments
Current GPT4Turbo route and alternative/restored data are not historical model/data snapshots
Public historical periods were already available to models and earlier project analysis
Quality flags match release defaults; unavailable factor-zoo comparison must be recorded as inactive rather than credited
Independent human source review remains external
